rules.title: Running processes, with command lines and owners
command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, ExecutablePath, CommandLine, @{n='CreationDate';e={if ($_.CreationDate) { $_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }}}, @{n='Owner';e={$o = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $_ -MethodName GetOwner -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($o.User) { "$($o.Domain)\$($o.User)" }}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rules.title: TCP connections and listening ports, with their processes
command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-NetTCPConnection | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, RemoteAddress, RemotePort, @{n='State';e={"$($_.State)"}}, OwningProcess, @{n='CreationTime';e={if ($_.CreationTime) { $_.CreationTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rules.title: UDP endpoints, with their processes
command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-NetUDPEndpoint | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess, @{n='CreationTime';e={if ($_.CreationTime) { $_.CreationTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rules.title: Services, with their binaries and accounts
command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, State, StartMode, PathName, ProcessId, StartName | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rules.title: DNS client cache
command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-DnsClientCache | Select-Object Entry, Name, Data, @{n='Type';e={"$($_.Type)"}}, TimeToLive | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rules.title: Logon sessions: interactive, remote desktop and cached, with their accounts
command: [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-CimInstance Win32_LogonSession -Filter 'LogonType = 2 or LogonType = 10 or LogonType = 11' | ForEach-Object { $session = $_; Get-CimAssociatedInstance -InputObject $session -ResultClassName Win32_Account | Select-Object @{n='Account';e={"$($_.Domain)\$($_.Name)"}}, @{n='LogonId';e={$session.LogonId}}, @{n='LogonType';e={$session.LogonType}}, @{n='StartTime';e={if ($session.StartTime) { $session.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }}} } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
